notes.title: The real Khaba found!
notes.notes:
Wow, look at this! They've found the real pyramid of Khaba in Egypt! 

http://www.alaraby.co.uk/english/news/2015/4/20/egypt-discovers-tomb-of-old-kingdom-pharaoh

The minister of antiquities, Mamdouh al-Damati, says "The discovery of this tomb is a great achievement. We still do not know much about this king and his dynasty, much study and research much be done to unveil its history."

They should just play the game and they will know all there is to know about the pharaoh! :)
